questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

During the last decade the typewriters (had give) way to the computers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Have given'**

• The given bracketed phrase is going to be replaced with **'have given'**
 
• **According to grammar, **whenever the subject of the sentence is 'singular' use a singular verb and for a plural noun use a plural verb.
 
• **In the given sentence, **the subject is 'typewriters' that is in the plural form hence use a plural verb 'have given' also with the perfect tense we need to use 'the third form of the verb.'

**So the correct sentence is-** *During the last decade, the typewriters **have given** way to the computers.*

questions.question: And it is hoped that the __________ method for the study
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Logical'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given blank,** we need an adjective because there is a definite article before the blank and after the blank, there is a noun i.e. 'method'
 
• Hence, here the adjective is used in an attributive manner. The structure for this is **'A/An/The + Adjective + Noun'**
 
• Let's see the options-
 
 
• Logic is a noun, Logics is a plural noun, Logical is an adjective, Logically is an adverb.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is** *'And it hoped that the** logical** method for the study'*

questions.question: much space to ________ attempt to find principles
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'an'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Attempt**' is a countable noun that means 'to do something, you try to do it, often without success.' H**ence, with countable nouns we can use 'the indefinite articles' the indefinite articles are 'a/an'.**
 
• **In this sentence,** we need to use** 'an**' because 'attempt' has a 'vowel' sound. With consonant sounding words, we have to use **'a'**

**So the correct sentence is-** *much space to **an attempt** to find principles*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

She threw me into a ditch.

options.text: I am threw by her into a ditch.
I was thrown into a ditch by her.
I was thrown into a ditch.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'I was thrown into a ditch by her.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject is 'she' and the verb is 'threw' i.e. in the past tense, and the indirect object 'me'
 
• **So the correct passive voice is-** *I was thrown into a ditch by her.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

The ideology of

P : modern economics suggests that

Q : enhanced satisfaction and well-being

R : material progress has yielded
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'PRQ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the fixed sentence, the last word is 'of' hence for this we need a noun to make a prepositional object. The noun is written in part P is 'modern economics' is going to be the prepositional object for the preposition.
 
• The last word in 'P' is 'that' hence after this, we need a verb that is written in part Q i.e. 'enhanced'
 
• So the correct sequence is- **PRQ**

 

***The ideology of modern economics suggests that material progress has yielded ****enhanced satisfaction and well-being ****.***

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

She kept thinking, “How lucky Serena ________!"
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'is'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An exclamatory sentence conveys strong emotion and ends with an exclamation mark.
 
• Let's see the sentence structure-
 
 
• **'How' is an adverb **
 
• **'Lucky' is an adjective.**
 
• **'Serena' is a noun that is the subject of the sentence.**
 
 
 
• **'Lucky' adjective is used for 'Serena' hence this is the subject complement and we know that the subject complement and the subject of the sentence are connected with the linking verbs.**
 
• In the given options, there is only one linking verb present i.e. 'is'

**So the correct sentence is-** She kept thinking, "how Lucky Serena **is**!"
